Tua Chua Shan tea and raw Shan Pu-erh tea

23/12/2025

Registration certificate No. 00149 covers Tua Chua Shan tea products.

Tua Chua Shan tea includes Shan tea and raw Shan Pu-erh tea.

The geographical area includes named communes in Tua Chua district.
